sources.text: The analytical FP8 linear path uses E4M3FN operands, dynamic FP32 scaling per token and 128 contraction features, and FP32 block-scaled accumulation followed by a BF16 output cast. The activation proxy counts six operations per input element and one per group. Gate/up pairs reuse one activation conversion. The graph models Q-A and KV-A as separate projections. Activation and scale tiles are assumed to stay on chip.

Steady-state absorbed MLA uses one BF16 working copy of the K/V up-projection rows. The DSA index key projection also uses BF16 resident weights, consistent with load-time upcasting in the fixed vLLM code. The estimate omits loading cost and any concurrent original checkpoint copies. Index scores, sparse attention, cache and collective formats follow the declared GLM-5.2 graph.
